units.source_zh: “首级在这里。”

units.source_en: Shōbee forced the words from his throat and held out the head to Sakuzaemon.
units.source_zh: 胜兵卫从喉咙里挤出这几个字，把首级拿给作左卫门。

units.source_en: Sakuzaemon hurriedly waved him away.
units.source_zh: 作左卫门慌忙摆了摆手。

units.source_en: “There is no time. You must take the head back to Sakamoto.”
units.source_zh: “时间紧迫，只能把首级带回坂本。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “首级在这里。”胜兵卫从喉咙里挤出这几个字，把首级拿给作左卫门。作左卫门慌忙摆了摆手。“时间紧迫，只能把首级带回坂本。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Leave the rest to me. No—I have decided to die here at my lord’s side. Mizoo, go!”

units.source_en: “Leave the rest to me.
units.source_zh: “剩下的事交给我了。

units.source_en: No—I have decided to die here at my lord’s side.
units.source_zh: 不，我决定在这里陪大人一起死。

units.source_en: Mizoo, go!”
units.source_zh: 沟尾，快！”

paragraphs.source_zh: “剩下的事交给我了。不，我决定在这里陪大人一起死。沟尾，快！”

paragraphs.source_en: Tatewaki lifted the headless body, choking on his sobs. “Fortune has deserted us... such a renowned commander...”

units.source_en: Tatewaki lifted the headless body, choking on his sobs.
units.source_zh: 带刀抱起无头尸体，泣不成声。

units.source_en: “Fortune has deserted us... such a renowned commander...”
units.source_zh: “武运不济……如此的名将……”

paragraphs.source_zh: 带刀抱起无头尸体，泣不成声。“武运不济……如此的名将……”

paragraphs.source_en: “That is a fine sword. Pick it up.”

units.source_en: “That is a fine sword. Pick it up.”
units.source_zh: “武刀不错，捡起来。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “武刀不错，捡起来。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Strip off the armor.”

units.source_en: “Strip off the armor.”
units.source_zh: “把盔甲扒下来。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “把盔甲扒下来。”

paragraphs.source_en: As the attackers howled, Tatewaki, determined not to let the bandits seize the body, lifted it and ran into the thicket where fewer voices could be heard, while Shinji Sakuzaemon followed with sword drawn to cover him. By then Shōbee, carrying Mitsuhide’s head, had already spurred his horse away and vanished without a trace.

units.source_en: As the attackers howled, Tatewaki, determined not to let the bandits seize the body, lifted it and ran into the thicket where fewer voices could be heard, while Shinji Sakuzaemon followed with sword drawn to cover him.
units.source_zh: 在袭击者哇哇大叫的时候，为了不让强盗得到尸体，带刀抱起尸体就向声音稀少的丛林中跑，进士作左卫门则提刀在后面掩护。

units.source_en: By then Shōbee, carrying Mitsuhide’s head, had already spurred his horse away and vanished without a trace.
units.source_zh: 此时，抱着光秀首级的胜兵卫早已快马加鞭，消失得无影无踪。

paragraphs.source_zh: 在袭击者哇哇大叫的时候，为了不让强盗得到尸体，带刀抱起尸体就向声音稀少的丛林中跑，进士作左卫门则提刀在后面掩护。此时，抱着光秀首级的胜兵卫早已快马加鞭，消失得无影无踪。

paragraphs.source_en: In human life, living is so long, yet dying is so swift and frail.

units.source_en: In human life, living is so long, yet dying is so swift and frail.
units.source_zh: 人生，生是那么漫长，死却是如此迅速而脆弱。

paragraphs.source_zh: 人生，生是那么漫长，死却是如此迅速而脆弱。

paragraphs.source_en: Before long, that ill-fated night came to an end. Mitsuhide’s body lay askew in a narrow ditch amid the thicket, limbs turned upward and half its length buried in the mud. Beside the road lay two bodies stripped naked, so horribly mutilated that no one could tell which was Shinji Sakuzaemon and which was Hida Tatewaki.

units.source_en: Before long, that ill-fated night came to an end.
units.source_zh: 不久，这不幸的一夜结束了。

units.source_en: Mitsuhide’s body lay askew in a narrow ditch amid the thicket, limbs turned upward and half its length buried in the mud.
units.source_zh: 光秀的尸体歪在丛林中的一条小沟里，四脚朝天，半截身子埋在泥土中。

units.source_en: Beside the road lay two bodies stripped naked, so horribly mutilated that no one could tell which was Shinji Sakuzaemon and which was Hida Tatewaki.
units.source_zh: 路边，有两具被剥光衣服的尸身，已经分辨不清哪一具是进士作左卫门，哪一具是比田带刀，惨不忍睹。

paragraphs.source_zh: 不久，这不幸的一夜结束了。光秀的尸体歪在丛林中的一条小沟里，四脚朝天，半截身子埋在泥土中。路边，有两具被剥光衣服的尸身，已经分辨不清哪一具是进士作左卫门，哪一具是比田带刀，惨不忍睹。

paragraphs.source_en: At dawn, utterly indifferent to what had occurred in the human world, the birds chirped merrily in the grove.

units.source_en: At dawn, utterly indifferent to what had occurred in the human world, the birds chirped merrily in the grove.

ja.t: しげにさえずっていた。

units.source_zh: 清晨，小鸟对人类世界发生之事丝毫不感兴趣，愉快地在林子里啁啾。

paragraphs.source_zh: 清晨，小鸟对人类世界发生之事丝毫不感兴趣，愉快地在林子里啁啾。

paragraphs.source_en: The sky showed blue.

units.source_en: The sky showed blue.
units.source_zh: 天空露出了蓝色。

paragraphs.source_zh: 天空露出了蓝色。
